contexts.text: Sheep, mentioned.
Sheep = those gifted with the good of charity; that is, with spiritual and natural good.
Lambs and sheep, sacrificed, = celestial things.
Signification of the Lord's other sheep. AC 2661:2. AC 2669:end.
Sheep are seen when Angels converse about rational goods, and probity.
The celestial are meant by, He calleth His Own sheep by name, and... goeth before them; but the spiritual by the other sheep (). AC 3969:10.
Sheep relate to the will.
Feed My sheep = those in charity (and thence in faith). AC 10087:3.
Thy sheep () = good of the will.
Sheep = goods. Illustrated.
Sheep = those in goods.
Sheep () = Divine goods.
The sheep with which they traded.
Sheep () = those in charity, and thence in truths of faith. ( = those in good: those are properly called sheep who are in charity and thence in faith. AC 4809:5.) AE 212:end. AE 600:5.
(Appearing of a sheep, which comforts them.)
The Lord's sheep = those in good.
Sheep of slaughter () = those in simple good, with whom truths of faith are extinguished by no fault of theirs, but by that of those who teach them.
The sheep () = those in charity and thence in faith.
Sheep = those in the good of charity from the Lord.
Sheep = those in the good of charity and of faith.
Sheep = the good of charity in the internal man.
Fleecy sheep seen in the First Earth.
The sheep lost and found () = good with the man who repents.
Feed My sheep (said twice) = those in the good of charity, and those in the good of faith.
The sheep on the Fifth Earth. Described.
Sheep and lambs correspond to affections of the spiritual mind.
On the Salvation of the sheep.
Sheep, in the Word, = charity.
He-goats seen striking sheep (showing that) charity from which is faith appears as a sheep.
Perfect animals are sheep, etc.
To call His sheep by name = everyone in the good of charity.
(Those in works alone) appear like sheep without wool; and those who place merit in works, like the same sheep daubed with dung.
Two flocks, one of he-goats, and one of sheep, seen. The latter had believed that charity and faith are one. TCR 506.
An Angel cried to the flock of sheep, Do not listen to them... The Angel divided the sheep into two flocks, and told those on the left to join the goats.
A conversation between the two flocks of sheep.
They saw a flock of sheep with lambs in a meadow, a sign that a city was near where charity is primary. TCR 388:4.
Kids, rams, she-goats, lambs, are here meant by sheep ().
We have seen how you feed these sheep.
They are called sheep, which is a great comfort to them.
They represent slaughtered sheep...
Sheep = those in the good of charity towards the neighbour. AE 315:11. AE 600:5.
Sheep = spiritual good.
The lost sheep of the house of Israel () = those in the good of charity and thence in faith.
Sheep, in the Word, = those in truths from good; thus in faith from charity. AE 298:13.
Sheep () = spiritual good.
Sheep = those in love towards the neighbour, which love is charity.
Occurs.
Sheep, in the Word, = those in the good of charity, (thus) the goods of charity.
The sheep on the mountains = those in the good of love and of charity; the one gone astray () = one not in that good, because from ignorance in falsities.
Other sheep I have which are not of this fold () = those not in Heaven before His advent, but introduced by Him after He had glorified His Human.
